properties.name: Baracsi II. dűlő

constructionEvidence.name: Baracsi II. dűlő
constructionEvidence.note: Broad whole Baracsi II dispersed farm/field district interpreted from actual diagonal farm lanes, forest/field interfaces, the main crossing road and the long southeastern lanes explicitly named Baracsi II. dűlő tanya. Source name and address mapping establish the agricultural locality; no formal dűlő perimeter was supplied. The irregular enclosure includes homesteads on both sides of the through-road and is a low-confidence practical agricultural extent, potentially overlapping neighboring Széktó/Mogyorós names.

properties.name: Csikósdűlő

constructionEvidence.name: Csikósdűlő
constructionEvidence.note: Whole former agricultural/farm block southwest of the main through-road, traced from the actual parallel diagonal farm lanes, woodland/plot edges and outer track junctions. Municipal utility planning names Csíkos dűlő, while the saved inventory spells Csikósdűlő; that possible spelling identity is recorded without changing the registry. The single native meadow was rejected as partial. The complete farm/field-lane group, not one meadow or point buffer, provides this rough practical extent.
